text: Retired
I am asking for your vote to be one of the next Saratoga City Council members. Experience is the key word for this election.

Before my wife and I moved to Saratoga, I was on the Sunnyvale City Council for nine years. During that time, I was the Mayor for three years. I was also a member of the VTA Board of Directors for seven years, and the Chair of the VTA Board in 2021. I served on the CalTrain Board of Directors.
I have experience making critical decisions, representing residents and community interests. I have made budgetary, public safety and housing decisions as part of these roles.
I am retired from a career in the high-tech sector as a Program Management Executive focused on delivering high volume financial transaction systems.
I would be honored to receive your vote to be your Saratoga Council Member.

text: Chairperson, Planning Commission
Ph.D in Nuclear Physics, Indiana University.
Postdoctoral Fellow, Harvard University.
I recently retired as Vice President from an online fraud prevention company.
Saratoga has been home to my family for 22 years. Raising my two sons through our public schools inspired me to volunteer with PTAs and school programs.

To give back to the city that I love deeply, I've dedicated years to serving Saratoga. On the Parks & Recreation Commission for 8 years, I launched "Let's Work, Saratoga!" to care for our local parks. Over the last 4+ years on the Planning Commission, currently as Chair, I've worked to strengthen city ordinances and guide development that respects our city's historic identity and community values. I also serve on the Trails Committee and Saratoga Historical Foundation board.

Saratoga is facing unprecedented challenges. On the City Council, I'll work with residents to keep our neighborhoods safe, ensure stewardship and oversight of city finances, meet housing needs while preserving our city's unique character, and promote & support local businesses. My experience and collaborative approach can help navigate the important decisions ahead.
It's been an honor serving Saratoga. I respectfully ask for your vote to continue on the City Council. www.electpingli.com.

text: Retired Programmer/Engineer

My wife and I chose Saratoga decades ago for its low-density housing, excellent schools, parks, and quality of life. Our children graduated from Saratoga High School. I have BS and MS degrees in Electrical Engineering from Purdue. I worked at Tandem, Compaq, and Hewlett Packard as an engineer, individual contributor, and manager. For the past several years, I have actively attended City Council, Planning, an Finance meetings, working with residents to protect Saratoga's future. My priorities are preserving Saratoga's character, completing the 2031 Housing Element on time to prevent future Builder's Remedy projects, I favor a state constitutional amendment taking housing and zoning decisions from Sacramento. Public safety means traffic enforcement, crime prevention, and stronger wildfire evacuation preparation. The City's operating costs continue to outpace revenues, while infrastructure, especially hillside streets, has been underfunded for too long. The Council must focus spending on essential services, maintenance, and critical public safety projects.
I respectfully ask for your vote. Questions? Please call or email. 408-891-2369 | BillDalton4SaratogaCouncil@yahoo.com

text: Commissioner, Saratoga Library and Public Arts Commission
I'm a longtime Saratoga resident, dedicated to serving our community. I currently serve on Saratoga's Library & Public Arts Commission.

I recently retired after 38 years with Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority, where I rose to manage 50+ employees across five locations—all while raising two sons as a single mother. I've learned that broken systems don't fix themselves until good people step up.
My roles have included Executive Board Member, Treasurer, and Political Director. I know how to lead, manage budgets, negotiate, and hold organizations accountable.

I'm running to protect Saratoga's quality of life, so it remains a safe, welcoming place to live, work, raise a family, and retire. I'll prioritize public safety, livable neighborhoods, our kids' education, and our parks and infrastructure. I'll make sure seniors have the resources they need to remain part of the community they helped build.
My endorsements include Assemblymember Patrick Ahrens, Santa Clara County District Attorney Jeff Rosen, Santa Clara County Supervisor Margaret Abe-Koga, and many more.
I'll bring transparency and accountability to City Hall, listen to residents before decisions are made, and ensure taxpayer dollars are spent responsibly. I hope to earn your vote.
www.JeriBromley4CityCouncil.com
